value.text: useMemoQueries.ts seems like it's the main module handling memo CRUD mutations and queries, so I should check it.
Now let's confirm where `memoServiceClient` is defined/generated.

`memoServiceClient` is a Connect-RPC client created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` is imported from the generated proto file `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.

q17. `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient` (a `@connectrpc/connect` client created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` in `web/src/connect.ts`, using the generated `MemoService` client from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`)

This module (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`) defines all the memo CRUD hooks (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, plus comment/link-metadata queries), and each calls methods on `memoServiceClient` (e.g. `memoServiceClient.listMemos`, `.getMemo`, `.createMemo`, `.updateMemo`, `.deleteMemo`). `memoServiceClient` itself is instantiated in `web/src/connect.ts` (line 197) via Connect-RPC's `createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` is the code-generated service definition from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
